title: stabpfn
summary: A research codebase (no README present) containing paper/ scripts that fit and sample tabular synthesizers over lists of datasets, apparently to benchmark a new synthesis method against established generators. The scripts import SDV's single-table API directly, running TVAESynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, and CTGANSynthesizer as comparison baselines.
